notes:
Snapshot from AE/SE/Customer threads - short bullets, rough style.
- Customer: Mariner InsightWorks (knowledge-base SaaS for mid-large customers). Primary product bundles KB+support chat.
- Scale: targeting ~1.2M indexed docs initially (KB articles + attachments), expect growth to ~3M in 12 months. Average doc length ~400-800 words.
- Traffic profile: high QPS on read/serve side — peak planned QPS 1,500-3,000 queries/s for embeddings retrieval; 400-800 qps for full rerank/cross-encoder stage.
- Architecture preference: two-stage retrieval: dense ANN (512-1536 dim embeddings) -> lightweight re-ranker cross-encoder for top-10. Want hosted API for POC and 6-9 month runway; open to Dedicated if costs scale.
- Latency targets: retrieval p95 < 40ms, end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) p95 < 180ms for top-3 responses. Hard SLA ask for p99 on critical enterprise customers.
- Cost constraints: goal <= $0.0025 per user query (avg), with envelope for peak traffic. Heavy sensitivity to tokenized reranker cost; exploring batching & quantized rerank models.
- Models: prefer open embeddings (fast, 1536 dims) + optimized cross-encoder (smaller, quantized) for rerank. Also evaluating Redwood-recommended quant/profile options.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys. Data segmentation per customer; EU data residency for 20% of customers.
- POC asks: ingest 200k doc sample (sanitized), run end-to-end test at 1k qps, deliver latency/cost report + tuning recommendations (batch sizes, cache policies).
- Quote from CTO: "Critical path is predictable unit economics — we need to know cost at scale before we commit."
- Internal champion: Head of Product (Emma Ruiz) & Platform Eng lead (Samir Anand). AE/SE engaged: Jordan Kim / Aisha Patel.
- Competitive pressure: customer also evaluating Pinecone + custom reranker infra; cost + latency + ops tooling are decision levers.
- Notes: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization) and Console tracing for token-level cost breakdown.
- Documents sent: security FAQ, initial ingest spec, sample data manifest.
- Status: POC running (ingest on 2026-03-08), rerank latency tests scheduled 2026-03-15.
- Other: ask to validate fallbacks (cheaper embed models) for unpredictable load.
